meta.label: Cluster defect instances
meta.description: RF-DETR localization, DINOv3 defect-instance embeddings, and spherical k-means review grouping.

inputRoles.name: images_folder
inputRoles.label: Images folder
inputRoles.description: Managed folder containing JPG/JPEG/PNG images. Nested paths are supported.

outputRoles.name: review_dataset
outputRoles.label: Review dataset
outputRoles.description: One row per input image with editable Dataiku object-detection prelabels and cluster context.

outputRoles.name: artifact_bundle
outputRoles.label: Embedding and run artifacts
outputRoles.description: Versioned caches, embeddings, centroids, manifests, failures, and provenance.

params.name: cluster_count
params.label: Number of clusters
params.description: Required number of spherical k-means review groups. Must not exceed the number of valid embedded instances.

params.name: detection_threshold
params.label: RF-DETR detection threshold
params.description: Candidate score threshold. The deployment default should be calibrated for recall.

params.name: box_padding_fraction
params.label: Box context fraction
params.description: Symmetric context added before DINOv3 feature extraction.

params.name: max_detections_per_image
params.label: Maximum defects per image
params.description: Safety cap after deterministic score sorting.

params.name: force_recompute
params.label: Recompute detections and embeddings
params.description: Ignore compatible detection and embedding caches for this run.
